description: Six-input logic gate combining pulse sources into one output, switchable between OR and NOR

params.text: Illuminated, the output carries the OR of the switched-on inputs; dark, it carries the NOR, resting at 5V and falling to 0V whenever a switched-on input goes high
Includes that input in the logic result while it is on, and leaves it out of the result while it is off

inputs.text: A gate or trigger into the logic, counted as high from 1V upwards

outputs.text: Carries 5V when the logic result is high and 0V when it is low

notes: with nothing patched to the inputs, switching from OR to NOR takes the output to a steady 5V, which makes the module a manual gate source
